citation: Government Notice No. 59 of 2022 — The Forest (Amendment) Regulations, 2022 (made under s. 106(1) of the Forest Act, Cap. 323)
renumberingNote: Cites s. 106(1) as printed at publication. In Cap. 323 R.E. 2023 the regulation-making power appears at s. 107 (see card a107). The as-printed citation is kept; it is not modernised.
commencementNote: No express commencement provision; publication date recorded, commencement not asserted.
signature: Damas Daniel Ndumbaro, Minister for Natural Resources and Tourism, Dodoma, 14th January, 2022

verification.note: Source: the official Gazette publication document uploaded by the maintainer (file name follows the TanzLII publication-document naming) - a born-digital PDF generated from Word 2016 with an embedded text layer, not a scan. The schedules transcript was OCR-extracted (the extraction environment could not read the text layer), corrected where deviations against the PDF were identified, and is held unverified: a token-level automated comparison against the text layer was run and its findings restored, but table structure was not machine-checked. The text is complete through the signature block (Dodoma, 14th January, 2022, Damas Daniel Ndumbaro). An earlier retrieval from the Tanzania Forest Services Agency website was truncated at the tail of ITEM XI (flowers) and had no signature block; that was an artifact of the earlier retrieval, not of the source. The Gazette citation 'Vol. 93 No. 15' carried in earlier records is unverified: the Gazette of 28/1/2022 is listed as No. 4 by official sources (utumishi.go.tz gazette of 28 Januari 2022, 'TOLEO NA. 4'; TanzLII file 'tz-government-gazette-dated-2022-01-28-no-4.pdf'), and the volume number is unconfirmed.
